-YELLOWSTONE'S ATTRACTIONS-
Yellowstone's Bear Show: Every night from 40 to 50 huge bears may be
seen
as they gather at feeding grounds located short distances from Old Faithful
Inn and Grand Canyon Hotel.
Native Brown Bears provide a spectacular show
near Old Faithful and giant Grizzlies gather at the Grand Canyon feeding
grounds.
While the bears feed, well informed Park Rangers describe the habits
of and tell exciting stories about this most interesting animal.

provides several fishing trips in the Park. The air passenger will be especial-

Scenic Air Tour Over Yellowstone
and Grand Teton Parks
(Effective June 10, 1936)
National Parks Airways operates an attractive SCENIC AIR TOUR OVER
YELLOWSTONE and GRAND TETON PARKS. This tour will be conducted
in a large multi-motored Boeing Transport and provides a ONE AND ONE-
HALF HOUR FLIGHT over a region of diversified and spectacular scenic
attractions.
CONNECTS WITH NPA SERVICE The Scenic Air Tour operates from West
Yellowstone airport where the Tour Plane connects with regular NPA schedules.
ATTRACTIVE FARE: The Scenic Air Tour fare is $7.50 per passenger.
When the tour is purchased in conjunction with a Salt Lake to West
Yellowstone round-trip ticket an all-inclusive fare of $35.00 applies.
THE COURSE: NPA'S Scenic Air Tour begins at West Yellowstone airport
from which point the plane flies over the Cascades of the Firehole and south
over the Lower and Upper Geyser Basins where Old Faithful and other
famous geysers may be seen 1-

YELLOWSTONE PARK SERVICE FACTS
SERVICE IS DIRECT: National Parks Airways service to Yellowstone Park is
direct:
West Yellowstone airport is only 3 minutes from the Government en-
trance to the Park by automobile.
BUS TOURS THROUCH YELLOWSTONE PARK: The
Transportation
Yellowstone
Park
Company operates a fleet of buses through the Park.
Com-
petent and well informed drivers operate these buses.
Two bus tours originate at West Yellowstone daily and National Parks Air-
ways planes connect with these schedules.
Passengers are transported free of
charge from West
Yellowstone airport to the Yellowstone Transportation Com-
pany station by NPA automobiles.
